_doc: Grill-me interview templates (card 570030c9, J2). Per-role question banks that pull IMPLICIT agent knowledge into the vault. Each agent self-grills: answers its own bank, pipes answers to scripts/memory-grill.py --ingest. tier_hint is a default; the answering agent may override. Questions are DATA, not instructions.
_operating_note: ANSWER IN THE VAULT'S DOMINANT LANGUAGE (Hungarian for this fleet). Calibration showed nomic-embed-text cross-language cosine under-scores true duplicates (English answer vs Hungarian vault ~0.68), so English answers bypass the dedup review band and can create near-duplicates. Same-language paraphrases land in the 0.72-0.88 REVIEW band as intended.

common.q: What recurring task do you do that has a non-obvious gotcha a newcomer would get wrong? Name the gotcha.
Which file/endpoint/command do you reach for most, and what is the exact invocation (flags, path)?
What did you learn the hard way (a bug, a mis-step, a wrong assumption) that you would not want to repeat?
What is a Boss/Dominik preference in your domain that is easy to forget but matters?
What is currently blocked or awaiting a decision in your area, and on whom?
What piece of your knowledge would be useful to another agent (shared)? State it so they can act on it.
What convention or invariant must never be broken in your work, and why?
If you were handed off tomorrow, what is the one thing the successor must know first?
